params.body:
Closes #465

## What was wrong

A piece made with "New piece" in the Studio is stored as `kind: own` in the post format. The Studio's Publish panel sends `kind: article, format: post, status: published` in one request, so that publishing moves the piece to gentells.com by itself.

`POST /articles/:id` ran `publishGate` on the stored piece before applying the update. The stored kind was still `own`, so the gate answered "own work is never published" for a post whose review was complete and signed. "Send for review" does not pass the gate, which is why only publishing failed.

## The change

- `kindAfter(article, fields)` in `packages/core/articles-store.mjs` says where a piece is headed once the fields are applied, by the rules `updateArticle` already follows: a format that is not a post makes it own work, otherwise a kind in the request decides, otherwise the piece stays what it is.
- The route passes the piece with that kind to `publishGate`. Nothing else about the gate changes: sources, inspiration hold, judged, signed.

## What stays refused

- `status: published` alone on own work.
- A request that gives the piece a format that is not a post (deck, article), whatever kind it names.
- A post moved to gentells.com whose review is not complete: it now gets the review's own reason ("not reviewed yet", "not signed") instead of the own-work refusal.

## Tests

`test/article-review.test.mjs` has a new case through the route with the exact fields the Studio sends: refused before the review with the review's reason and nothing changed on the piece, refused without the move and with a deck format, then published with kind `article` and a date. Full suite: 1699 pass. Typecheck clean.

Source: Portal mail:54.
params.title: Publish a reviewed post that started as own work
